mechanism: Moving from specific observations ({{datum}}) to general rules. The conclusion is probable, not certain. Induction has no formal justification and never acquires one, so what the pattern requires is disclosure rather than soundness.
invariants: A conclusion states the observations it generalises from and their range.
Generalization: the output rule covers more cases than the input {{datum}}.
failure_modes: Unbounded extrapolation: the rule is applied outside the range the observations covered.
Unrepresentative sample: the rule is well supported and the range was never the right one.
